title: Secret Tender
tagline: Facilitate secure and confidential tender processes for Web3 projects & DAO seeking auditing services. By doing the process on-chain, we ensure transparency and fairness for both project owners and auditing firms.

prizes.placement: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer
prizes.title: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description:
This platform is designed to facilitate secure and confidential tender processes for Web3 projects participating in RFP and DAO Governance. By doing the process on-chain, we ensure that the secret is respected and that a secret proof of funds solution is applicable.

At the Era of internet Companies it enables strategy privacy and therefore Competitiveness. Protect your IP, your research, your innovation, your strategy, your pricing system...

This platform allows Web3 projects to:

- Create confidential tenders / proposals
- Link a Sealed proposal to complete a traditional proposal
- Host fair RFP, with private entry that appear at the end of the contest

It's not because it's on internet that everybody needs to know what you are doing,

For auditing firms, the platform:

Provides an opportunity to submit proposals directly to any Web3 project.
Ensures a fair and transparent process where the best proposal (chosen by the tender's project) wins.

Key Features

- Secure and Confidential: All tenders and proposals are encrypted to ensure confidentiality and fairness. They are only visible to the project owners after the tender is closed. In this way other auditing firms cannot copy the proposals of their competitors.
- Transparency: Projects can view past performance data of auditing firms.
- Fair Competition: Auditing firms can submit proposals directly to projects without intermediaries.
- On-chain: Ensures the integrity and immutability of the tender process.
